map.分母用当年实际天数（闰年 366），分子用真实在职天数，比例法自动适配。: The denominator uses the actual days in that year (366 in a leap year) and the numerator uses the real days employed, so the ratio method adapts automatically.
map.填写「折算截止日期（当年12/31 或离职日）」。: Enter the "proration end date (12/31 of that year or the resignation date)".
map.当年离职员工，按在职截止日折算，HR 据此结算未休年假工资。: For an employee who leaves during the year, prorate by the last day employed, and HR settles the pay for unused annual leave accordingly.
map.折算不足 1 天怎么处理？: How Is a Fraction Shorter Than 1 Day Handled?
map.按条例不足 1 整天部分通常不折算，多数企业取 0.5 天为最小单位，具体以公司: Under the regulations, a fraction shorter than a full day is usually not prorated; most companies take 0.5 day as the smallest unit, but the company policy governs.
map.累计工龄决定档位天数，再乘当年在职天数占比得到可用天数。: Cumulative years of service determine the tier of days, which is then multiplied by the proportion of days employed that year to give the available days.
